what: The proposed SECURITY.md bullet says invalid or unclassified workflow auxiliary JSON makes the run fall back to unknown, but the scanner keeps checking later auxiliary files and uses a valid SIMPLE/HARD value if one is found.
scenario_or_breakage: A run with invalid timing-report-final.json but valid run-params.json is documented as unknown even though _workflow returns the run-params classification.
suggested_fix: Revise the bullet to say invalid or unclassified auxiliary artifacts are ignored with a warning, and the run is retained with workflow unknown only when no valid SIMPLE/HARD auxiliary classification is found.
